title: Plasmon-Mediated Whispering-Gallery-Mode Emission from Quantum-Dot-Coated Gold Nanosphere

source_inventory.title: Plasmon-Mediated Whispering-Gallery-Mode Emission from Quantum-Dot-Coated Gold Nanosphere
source_inventory.scope: Main-only commercial particle inputs, electrostatic assembly, distinct size specimens, optical/decay controls, polarization/interference contexts and qualified source analytical calculations.
source_conflicts: Main PDF p.1 Methods prints QD concentration 4 x 10^-6 M/L. The unit is retained literally; M/L is not silently rewritten as mol/L.
Main PDF p.1 Methods prints QD stock concentration 4 x 10^-6 M/L; retain that literal unit. Abstract room-temperature emission is not a reported synthesis temperature.

Main PDF p.3 Section 3.3 gives the unshifted fit I1 cos(2 theta)+I0 and reports the observed intensity maximum at +10 degrees. Both statements are retained; no phase parameter or corrected extremum is invented.

Main PDF p.4 Section 3.5 reports Q=80, lambda=625 nm, n approximately2.07 and Veff approximately223^3 nm^3, then F=1.51. Direct substitution into its printed formula gives approximately15.09. Both the source result and explicitly labelled extractor arithmetic check are retained; no experimental value is silently repaired.
limitations: Matching SI unavailable locally, not a global absence claim. Cited external methods are excluded.
General coating recipe does not supply separate numerical size-variant charges or exact physical-batch identifiers.
No curve digitization or atom/particle reconstruction.
Optical spot size, physical particle size and image-pixel profile coordinates are separate.
